nodes.name: Sol-gel synthesis of NiMn0.04 solid solution
nodes.procedure: Nitrate used as metal precursor and citric acid as chelating agent to prepare NiMn0.04 solid solution, uniformly mixed, aged, dry gel heated at 800°C for 4h.

nodes.name: Electrodeposition of ZnO NRA on NF

nodes.name: Electrodeposition of CeO2 on ZnO
nodes.procedure: CeO2 layer coated on surface of ZnO NRAs by electrodeposition in solution containing 2 mM Ce(NO3)2 and 10 mM NaCl to form ZnO@CeO2 NRAs-NF electrode.
